Question B-005-001-009. Lesson link: L-005-01.

Why the correct answer is right: One volt is 1 000 millivolts, so two volts is 2 000 mV.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: This is far too small and moves the decimal in the wrong direction.
- sourceIndex 2: This is too large by a factor of 1 000.
- sourceIndex 3: This is too small by a factor of 1 000 000.
